executive_summary: Canada is experiencing an unprecedented ransomware crisis with 106 Canadian organizations compromised in the last 48 hours across all sectors. High-profile victims include Canada Goose, National Money Mart (database leaked), Peterborough Public Health, Eastern Townships School Board, and Municipality of North Perth. The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security has issued two critical alerts: CVE-2026-45659 affecting Microsoft SharePoint Server and CVE-2026-8451 impacting Citrix NetScaler, both requiring immediate patching. The Qilin ransomware group alone has claimed 18 Canadian victims, followed by Play (11), Safepay (10), and Clop (13), indicating coordinated campaigns targeting Canadian infrastructure.

canada_landscape.summary: Canada is experiencing a mass ransomware event with 106 organizations breached across all sectors including public health, education, municipal governments, and critical infrastructure. CCCS has issued two critical advisories (AL26-015 and AL26-016) for Microsoft SharePoint Server CVE-2026-45659 and Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8451 requiring immediate remediation. High-impact victims include Canada Goose, National Money Mart with confirmed database leak, Peterborough Public Health, Eastern Townships School Board, and Municipality of North Perth.
canada_landscape.retailers: Canada Goose breached by Coinbasecartel ransomware group; Active Green + Ross breached by Sinobi; Kids & Company breached by Sinobi
canada_landscape.financial: National Money Mart Company database leaked by Everest ransomware; Morison Insurance Brokers breached by Sinobi; Trucash breached by Lynx; multiple accounting and financial services firms compromised including Pewarchuk CPA, MG Chartered Professional Accountant, Axion50plus, reidhurstnagy.com

report_2w.executive_summary: Multiple zero-day vulnerabilities are under active exploitation: CVE-2026-33825 (Microsoft Defender), CVE-2026-20245 (Cisco SD-WAN), CVE-2026-12569 (PTC Windchill), and CVE-2026-48558 (SimpleHelp). Progress Kemp LoadMaster faces active pre-authentication remote code execution attempts. Major breaches include Aflac Japan (millions affected), Nissan (linked to Oracle zero-day attacks), HealthNet Insurance (11 million patient records exposed via misconfigured AWS), and Illinois Central College. Qilin and Akira ransomware groups remain highly active with multiple new victims reported.
